environment.description: Same EKS cluster and Go 1.19.x image. The internal ALB serving the webhook endpoint has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a rule group reference statement pointing to a custom rule (not a managed group) with priority 1 that uses a RegexPatternSet matching `[\r\n]` characters in specific header names (X-Correlation-ID, X-Forwarded-User-Agent, X-Content-Type) with action BLOCK. However, the WAFv2 inspection is configured with `FieldToMatch` set to `SingleHeader` with name matching performed case-insensitively. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Note: WAFv2 header inspection for ALB operates on the inbound HTTP request headers at the ALB layer before forwarding to target group. The scope is REGIONAL. The rule uses `TextTransformation` with priority 0 and type `NONE` (no normalization). The regex pattern set contains the single pattern: `[\x0d\x0a\x00]`.

config.network: Pod-to-ALB via ClusterIP, ALB has WAFv2 WebACL associated
config.kafka_acl: producers have WRITE on topic headers without restriction
config.webhook_alb: internal ALB with WAFv2 WebACL associated (regional scope)
